title: Laptop Battery Health
description: Generate battery evidence, inspect power settings, and summarize battery wear, runtime risk, and next steps.
starter_prompt: Check laptop battery health and explain any wear or runtime risk.

phases.prompt: Scope battery-health evidence and note that battery report generation writes a diagnostic artifact only.

arguments.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $powercfg=Join-Path $env:SystemRoot 'System32\powercfg.exe'; if(-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $powercfg -PathType Leaf)){ throw ('powercfg.exe not found at ' + $powercfg) }; $stamp=''+$PID+'-'+(Get-Date).Ticks; $htmlPath=Join-Path $env:TEMP ('sak-battery-report-'+$stamp+'.html'); $xmlPath=Join-Path $env:TEMP ('sak-battery-report-'+$stamp+'.xml'); foreach($p in @($htmlPath,$xmlPath)){ if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $p){ throw ('Battery report path already exists, refusing to overwrite: ' + $p) } }; $batteries=@(Get-CimInstance Win32_Battery); Write-Output ('== Battery devices reported by Win32_Battery: ' + $batteries.Count + ' =='); if($batteries.Count -gt 0){ $batteries | Select-Object Name,Status,BatteryStatus,EstimatedChargeRemaining,EstimatedRunTime | Format-List }; Write-Output '== powercfg battery report =='; $htmlExit=-1; try { & $powercfg /batteryreport /output $htmlPath 2>&1 | Out-String | Write-Output; $htmlExit=$LASTEXITCODE } catch { Write-Output ('[error] powercfg /batteryreport (html) failed: ' + $_.Exception.Message) }; $xmlExit=-1; try { & $powercfg /batteryreport /output $xmlPath /xml 2>&1 | Out-String | Write-Output; $xmlExit=$LASTEXITCODE } catch { Write-Output ('[error] powercfg /batteryreport (xml) failed: ' + $_.Exception.Message) }; $htmlOk=($htmlExit -eq 0) -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath $htmlPath -PathType Leaf); $xmlOk=($xmlExit -eq 0) -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath $xmlPath -PathType Leaf); if($htmlOk){ Write-Output ('Battery report: ' + $htmlPath) }; if(-not ($htmlOk -and $xmlOk)){ if($batteries.Count -eq 0){ Write-Output ('No battery present, so powercfg battery report is unavailable on this system (html exit ' + $htmlExit + ', xml exit ' + $xmlExit + ').') } else { throw ('powercfg /batteryreport failed (html exit ' + $htmlExit + ', xml exit ' + $xmlExit + ') while ' + $batteries.Count + ' battery device(s) are present') } }; if($xmlOk){ Write-Output '== Battery capacity and cycle evidence =='; $doc=[xml](Get-Content -LiteralPath $xmlPath -Raw); $found=0; foreach($battery in @($doc.BatteryReport.Batteries.Battery)){ if($null -eq $battery){ continue }; $found=$found+1; $design=[int64]$battery.DesignCapacity; $full=[int64]$battery.FullChargeCapacity; $wear='unknown'; if($design -gt 0){ $wear=''+[int]((100*($design-$full))/$design)+' percent' }; Write-Output ('battery_id=' + $battery.id + ' design_capacity_mwh=' + $design + ' full_charge_capacity_mwh=' + $full + ' cycle_count=' + $battery.CycleCount + ' wear=' + $wear) }; if($found -eq 0){ if($batteries.Count -gt 0){ throw 'Battery report XML carries no battery entries although Win32_Battery reported devices' } else { Write-Output 'Battery report XML carries no battery entries, consistent with a system that has no battery.' } } }; Write-Output '== Active power scheme =='; $schemeExit=-1; try { & $powercfg /getactivescheme 2>&1 | Out-String | Write-Output; $schemeExit=$LASTEXITCODE } catch { Write-Output ('[error] powercfg /getactivescheme failed: ' + $_.Exception.Message) }; if($schemeExit -ne 0){ throw ('powercfg /getactivescheme failed with exit code ' + $schemeExit) }

phases.prompt: Generate the battery report artifact into a fresh per-run path, parse design capacity, full-charge capacity, cycle count, and wear out of the report XML, and collect battery/power-plan evidence. Do not change settings.
phases.completion: Battery report path, parsed capacity/cycle/wear values, and power-plan evidence are captured, or the absence of a battery is stated explicitly.

phases.prompt: Analyze battery evidence. Use only the design_capacity_mwh, full_charge_capacity_mwh, cycle_count, and wear values captured by the evidence phase; state wear as unknown when those values are absent instead of estimating them, and do not claim to have read the report file. Summarize wear/runtime concerns, missing data, whether the device appears to have a battery, and next steps.
phases.completion: Battery findings are prioritized and every wear claim cites a captured capacity value.

phases.prompt: Check that findings distinguish generated report artifact, live battery status, and unsupported desktop/no-battery cases.

Create a technician and customer-ready handoff report with evidence, findings, actions/tools used, verification status, artifacts/logs, cleanup status, residual risk, and prioritized follow-up next actions.
Keep battery report path, logs, and reports. Remove only workflow-created scratch files if user asks.

acceptance_criteria: Battery report artifact path is captured when supported.
Battery and active power-plan evidence are reviewed.
Final report includes evidence, actions, cleanup status, risks, and follow-up items.
